title: Resolve class starting equipment into deterministic item grants
description:
Problem:
Class starting equipment is currently much better than raw prose, but many entries are still string-based. Examples:
- 'a greataxe'
- 'any martial melee weapon'
- 'Leather armor, any simple weapon, and two daggers'

This is not enough for deterministic inventory tools. Character creation needs item refs, quantities, and filters.

Implement:
- Add a typed representation for starting equipment grants.
- Convert fixed items to stable equipment refs and quantities.
- Convert open choices to deterministic filters, for example:
  - any simple weapon
  - any martial melee weapon
  - any martial weapon
  - a shield
  - a component pouch or arcane focus
- Preserve original SRD text alongside typed grants for auditability.
- Fail or report when a class starting equipment entry cannot be resolved.
- Cover all classes in the SRD pack.

Acceptance criteria:
- A deterministic character creation flow can grant class starting equipment without parsing prose.
- All fixed items resolve to equipment record ids.
- All equipment choices resolve to typed filters or explicit option sets.
- Quantities are represented explicitly.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
